'Quiero' can sound blunt; 'quisiera' softens the request.
drills.prompt: Make it polite using 'quisiera': Quiero una habitación individual.

focus_note: Use 'quisiera' (I would like) instead of 'quiero' (I want) to make requests sound polite. It works with a noun or an infinitive. Example: 'Quisiera un billete para Madrid' (I'd like a ticket to Madrid). 'Quería' and 'querría' are also common and polite.
